def transform(grid):
    """Move the non-background object up against the full-width divider,
    then mark a full-width 8 stripe just beyond the object on its far side.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The background is the most common color; a full-width other-color row
    # is the divider.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    line_color = grid[divider][0]
    obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not obj:
        return out
    rmin = min(r for r, c, v in obj)
    rmax = max(r for r, c, v in obj)
    if rmax < divider:  # object above: slide down, touching divider
        new_min = divider - (rmax - rmin) - 1
        dr = new_min - rmin
        trail_row = new_min - 1
    elif rmin > divider:  # object below: slide up, touching divider
        new_min = divider + 1
        dr = new_min - rmin
        trail_row = new_min + (rmax - rmin) + 1
    else:
        return out
    # Clear the original object, then place its unchanged shape.
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[r + dr][c] = v
    if 0 <= trail_row < h:
        out[trail_row] = [8] * w
    return out
